title: PUMAS_interface_215: patches to run PUMAS cloud microphysics in CESM 2.1.5 CAM6
description: Patches that let the CAM6 atmosphere of CESM 2.1.5 (CAM tag cam_cesm2_1_rel_60) run the current PUMAS cloud microphysics (ESCOMP/PUMAS) as micro_mg_version = 3, with PUMAS itself unmodified. The repository includes minimal namelists and a script that checks the pinned commits and applies the patches.
